verzen.tekst: But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of God,
verzen.html: But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of God,

verzen.tekst: In the eyes of the foolish they seemed to have died.
verzen.html: In the eyes of the foolish they seemed to have died.

verzen.tekst: and their travel away from us ruin,
verzen.html: and their travel away from us ruin,

verzen.tekst: For even if in the sight of men they are punished,
verzen.html: For even if in the sight of men they are punished,

verzen.tekst: Having borne a little chastening, they will receive great good;
verzen.html: Having borne a little chastening, they will receive great good;

verzen.tekst: He tested them like gold in the furnace,
verzen.html: He tested them like gold in the furnace,

verzen.tekst: In the time of their visitation they will shine.
verzen.html: In the time of their visitation they will shine.

verzen.tekst: They will judge nations and have dominion over peoples.
verzen.html: They will judge nations and have dominion over peoples.

verzen.tekst: Those who trust him will understand truth.
verzen.html: Those who trust him will understand truth.

verzen.tekst: But the ungodly will be punished even as their reasoning deserves,
verzen.html: But the ungodly will be punished even as their reasoning deserves,

verzen.tekst: for he who despises wisdom and discipline is miserable.
verzen.html: for he who despises wisdom and discipline is miserable.

verzen.tekst: Their wives are foolish and their children are wicked.
verzen.html: Their wives are foolish and their children are wicked.

verzen.tekst: So is the eunuch which has done no lawless deed with his hands,
verzen.html: So is the eunuch which has done no lawless deed with his hands,

verzen.tekst: For good labours have fruit of great renown.
verzen.html: For good labours have fruit of great renown.

verzen.tekst: But children of adulterers will not come to maturity.
verzen.html: But children of adulterers will not come to maturity.

verzen.tekst: For if they live long, they will not be esteemed,
verzen.html: For if they live long, they will not be esteemed,

verzen.tekst: If they die young, they will have no hope,
verzen.html: If they die young, they will have no hope,

verzen.tekst: For the end of an unrighteous generation is always grievous.
verzen.html: For the end of an unrighteous generation is always grievous.
